operations.operation: one fixed-shape model forward for each non-empty exploration batch
operations.estimated_complexity: O(1) with respect to current graph size
operations.likely_runtime_impact: GPU cost is bounded; sampled GPU utilization was 0% while CPU remained about 160%, so it does not explain the late graph-size-dependent slowdown.

operations.operation: edge_rtree window query followed by two OpenCV line draws for every returned directed edge
operations.estimated_complexity: O(log E + k_window), degenerating toward O(E) when dense/duplicate edges overlap the 256x256 window
operations.likely_runtime_impact: HIGH; the R-tree is output-sensitive and no direction/duplicate suppression is applied in the walked-path loop.

operations.operation: insert each accepted directed edge into a dynamic spatial index
operations.estimated_complexity: Expected O(log E) per directed edge insertion
operations.likely_runtime_impact: MEDIUM; after iteration 2000 almost every iteration inserts two or four directed edges.

operations.operation: exact-point R-tree query followed by a scan of all intersecting edge ids and both endpoints
operations.likely_runtime_impact: HIGH when many duplicate/overlapping edges share a coordinate.

operations.operation: R-tree range queries over key points and generated anchor points, removal of locally explored points, and nearest-endpoint scans
operations.likely_runtime_impact: MEDIUM_TO_HIGH when the local anchor density grows.

operations.operation: depth-limited adjacency traversal and nested duplicate/opposite-edge scan
operations.estimated_complexity: Local O(d^2) in get_nearby_edge_segments; depth-2 traversal grows with local degree
operations.likely_runtime_impact: MEDIUM_TO_HIGH if repeated connections inflate local degree.

operations.operation: threshold and connected-component analysis on up to four 256x256 maps
operations.estimated_complexity: O(NUM_TARGETS * WINDOW_SIZE^2), constant with respect to graph size
operations.likely_runtime_impact: BOUNDED; cannot explain the monotonic graph-size correlation by itself.

operations.operation: road-segment reconstruction, full edge scan, coordinate vertex deduplication, and serialization
operations.estimated_complexity: At least O(V + E), plus road-segment construction
operations.likely_runtime_impact: END_ONLY; not responsible for current exploration slowdown.

operations.operation: NetworkX shortest paths, all-pairs candidate construction for greedy matching, and graph metric calculation
operations.estimated_complexity: Post-run Dijkstra plus O(V_reference * V_candidate) matching candidates and sorting
operations.likely_runtime_impact: POST_COMPLETION_ONLY; not yet running for C1-best.

empirical_scaling.interpretation: Per-iteration CPU work grows strongly with accumulated graph scale. Source inspection points to output-sensitive R-tree queries, drawing all locally intersecting directed edges, and local-degree scans rather than a per-iteration NetworkX/global-serialization call.

dominant_runtime_assessment: CPU-side local graph-density amplification; exact per-function attribution is INCONCLUSIVE without profiling instrumentation, which was intentionally not added to the live process.
